Qualified students, parents, and educators still have a few weeks to take advantage of Apple's 2026 back-to-school promotion on select Mac and iPad models. Here's what you need to know.

Apple's 2026 back-to-school promotion has been extended to September 24

According to MacRumors, Apple has updated the promotional period for its 2026 back-to-school offer. The original end date of August 27 has now been extended to September 24, with the promotion originally running from July 16 to August 27.

This year, in addition to standard educational pricing on Mac and iPad, qualified students who purchase an eligible Mac or iPad can also receive an Apple gift card worth up to $150.

Below is the official list from Apple detailing the gift card amount included with each eligible Mac and iPad purchase:

Product Category Eligible Products Promotion Product Mac MacBook Pro $150 Apple Gift Card Mac MacBook Air $100 Apple Gift Card iPad iPad Air $100 Apple Gift Card iPad iPad Pro $100 Apple Gift Card

According to the terms and conditions of the "2026 Higher Education Student Promotion":

Eligible participants in this promotion include faculty, students, and parents (collectively referred to as "Qualified Buyers"), as detailed below: K–12 – Faculty and staff of public and private K–12 institutions in the U.S., as well as homeschool teachers, are all eligible. Additionally, current members of elected or appointed school boards are eligible. Current members of elected or appointed Parent-Teacher Association (PTA or PTO) executive committees are also eligible. Higher Education – Faculty and staff teaching at U.S. higher education institutions, as well as currently enrolled or admitted students, are eligible. Parents of Higher Education Students – Parents purchasing on behalf of their children, provided the child is currently enrolled or admitted to a public or private U.S. higher education institution, are also eligible. Personal purchases made through the Apple Education Store do not apply to institutional purchases or resale purposes.

If you don't qualify, or the promotion has ended, you can still find discounts through Apple's official Amazon storefront, with prices even lower than Apple's standard educational pricing.

You can also shop through the Apple Certified Refurbished Store, where you can purchase a variety of products at up to 15% off.
